name: GetTemplateParameterConstraints

parameters.help_en:
The structure of the template body. The template body must be 1 to 524,288 bytes in length. If the length of the template body exceeds the upper limit, we recommended to use the HTTP POST + Body Param method to pass the parameter in the request body to avoid request failures caused by an excessively long URL.

You can specify only one of the following parameters: TemplateBody, TemplateURL, TemplateId, and TemplateScratchId
parameters.help_zh:
模板主体的结构。长度为1~524,288个字节。如果长度较长，则建议通过HTTP POST+Body Param的方式，将参数放在请求体中进行传递，避免因URL过长而导致请求失败。

您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL、TemplateId和TemplateScratchId其中一个参数
parameters.name: template_body

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。  
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html接口查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the file that contains the template body. The URL must point to a template that is located on an HTTP or HTTPS web server or in an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket, such as oss\://ros/template/demo or oss\://ros/template/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou. The template must be 1 to 524,288 bytes in length. If the OSS region is not specified, the default is the same as the RegionId parameter.

You can specify only one of the TemplateBody, TemplateURL, and TemplateId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
包含模板主体的文件的位置。URL必须指向位于Web服务器（HTTP或HTTPS）或阿里云OSS存储空间（例如：oss://ros/template/demo或oss://ros/template/demo?RegionId=cn-hangzhou）中的模板，模板的最大长度为524,288个字节。如未指定OSS地域，默认与接口参数RegionId相同。
您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL和TemplateId其中一个参数。
parameters.name: template_url

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the template. This parameter applies to shared templates and private templates.

You can specify only one of the TemplateBody, TemplateURL, and TemplateId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
模板ID。支持共享模板和私有模板。  
您必须且仅能指定TemplateBody、TemplateURL和TemplateId其中一个参数。
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the template. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version is used.

TemplateVersion is valid only when TemplateId is specified
parameters.help_zh:
模板版本。如果不指定，默认取最新版本。  

TemplateVersion仅在指定TemplateId时生效
parameters.name: template_version

fields.help_en:
The name of the parameter that is defined in the template.

The Parameters parameter is optional. If you specify Parameters, you must specify ParameterKey
fields.help_zh:
模板中已定义的参数的名称。

Parameters为可选参数。若指定了Parameters，则ParameterKey为必选参数
fields.name: parameter_key

fields.help_en:
The value of the parameter that is defined in the template.

The Parameters parameter is optional. If you specify Parameters, you must specify ParameterValue
fields.help_zh:
模板中已定义的参数的取值。

Parameters为可选参数。若指定了Parameters，则ParameterValue为必选参数
fields.name: parameter_value

parameters.help_en: The parameters that are defined in the template
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The list of parameters to be queried
parameters.name: parameters_key_filter

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求的幂等性。
该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。长度不超过64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the stack.

If you specify this parameter, the parameter constraints for an upgrade or downgrade scenario are queried
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈ID。

当填写此参数时，表示查询变配场景的参数约束
parameters.name: stack_id

ParameterConstraints.description_en: The information about the parameter constraints

AllowedValues.description_en: The list of valid values of the parameter

items.description_en: The valid value of the parameter

AssociationParameterNames.description_en: The names of the associated parameters

items.description_en: The name of an associated parameter

Behavior.description_en:
The behavior of the parameter. Valid values:

NoLimit: The parameter has no limit on its valid values.

NotSupport: The valid values of the parameter cannot be queried.

QueryError: The query failed.

If AllowedValues is not returned, Behavior and BehaviorReason are returned to indicate the behavior of the parameter and the reason for the behavior
Behavior.description_zh:
参数的行为。取值：

NoLimit：无限制，此参数没有取值限制。

NotSupport：不支持，此参数不支持查询取值。

QueryError：查询失败。

当查询结果没有返回AllowedValues时，会额外返回Behavior和BehaviorReason，说明参数的行为和原因

BehaviorReason.description_en: The reason for the behavior of the parameter
BehaviorReason.example: No resource property refer to the parameter

IllegalValueByParameterConstraints.description_en:
The values that do not match the parameter constraints.

If AllowedValues is returned, IllegalValueByParameterConstraints and IllegalValueByRules are returned to indicate the invalid values that are filtered out by the parameter constraints and template rules
IllegalValueByParameterConstraints.description_zh:
不符合参数约束的值列表。

当查询结果有返回AllowedValues时，会额外返回IllegalValueByParameterConstraints和IllegalValueByRules，说明被参数约束和模板规则过滤掉的不合法的值

items.description_en:
The value that does not match the parameter constraints.

If `AllowedValues` is returned, the invalid values that are filtered out by the parameter constraints and template rules are returned in the `IllegalValueByParameterConstraints` and `IllegalValueByRules` parameters
items.description_zh:
不符合参数约束的值。
当查询结果返回`AllowedValues`时，会同时返回被参数约束和模板规则过滤掉的不合法的值`IllegalValueByParameterConstraints`和`IllegalValueByRules`

IllegalValueByRules.description_en:
The values that do not match the template rules.

If AllowedValues is returned, IllegalValueByParameterConstraints and IllegalValueByRules are returned to indicate the invalid values that are filtered out by the parameter constraints and template rules
IllegalValueByRules.description_zh:
不符合模板规则的值列表。

当查询结果有返回AllowedValues时，会额外返回IllegalValueByParameterConstraints和IllegalValueByRules，说明被参数约束和模板规则过滤掉的不合法的值

items.description_en:
The value that does not match the template rules.

If `AllowedValues` is returned, the invalid values that are filtered out by the parameter constraints and template rules are returned in the `IllegalValueByParameterConstraints` and `IllegalValueByRules` parameters

不符合模板规则的值。
当查询结果返回`AllowedValues`时，会同时返回被参数约束和模板规则过滤掉的不合法的值`IllegalValueByParameterConstraints`和`IllegalValueByRules`
